description: Lists the people, companies and DAO LLCs this account may act for as a domain registrant, with its role on each (owner or operator) and how many domains each holds. A DAO LLC entry also carries its state, filing number, whether the filing was checked or only stated by the owner, its smart contract identifier, and the wallets proven to control it. For when the user asks who holds their domains, or which company or DAO LLC a name sits under. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
name: list_entities
